title: The Whole Argument
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（生活与学习·健康医疗）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（生活与学习·健康医疗）　|　核心词汇：body　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 body 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my mother was sent to measure ① a body she could not lift, and she said the lifting was the whole of the lesson. The ② body, meaning the frame and not the person, was sixty kilos and was carried by whoever came last; a body, she said, is the only thing in a clinic that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ body in that class had the same chart, and the ④ body at the front, meaning the one the surgeon stood at and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured properly. A body, my grandmother said, is nine parts water and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the water is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ body was the whole of the person, meaning the self and not the frame. The ⑥ body, meaning the person and not any of that, is the only thing in a family that everybody greets and nobody questions; a body, he said, is either something you measure or the only word that means both a frame and a person. She said the person is the part they remember.

By 1967 the ⑦ body had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the water. The ⑧ body of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was sixty kilos of frame and eleven years of measuring; a body, she said, is either the one at the front or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ body I remember is the one at the front, which was drawn in 1972 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ body, my grandmother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being rested; every body, she said, is a person that has agreed to look like a frame. She said the person was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 身体（指躯体本身，与人相对）
C. 固定搭配：measure a body 测量一具躯体
D. n. 身体（指课上每一具）
E. n. 身体（指前面那一具）
F. n. 人；整个人（抽象：与躯体相对）
G. n. 人（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 主体；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a body she could not lift
The body, meaning the frame and not the person
body was the whole of the person
the body had become a number in a report
The body of the whole thing
A body, my grandmother said in 1978

answers.why: measure a body 意为“测量一具躯体”，1949 年母亲被派去测量一具她抬不动的躯体。
body 意为“身体”，指躯体本身而不是那个人，重六十公斤，由最后走的人抬走。
body 指那堂课上每一具躯体，每一具都是同一张图表。
body 指前面那一具（外科医生站的那一具），是唯一有人认真测量过的。
body 意为“人、整个人”，与躯体相对，父亲说 body 就是那个人的全部。
body 为抽象用法，指那个人本身，是一家人里人人都招呼、却没人质疑的东西。
body 意为“身体、躯干”，到 1967 年这个 body 成了报告里的一个数字。
body 意为“主体、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事的主体是六十公斤的躯体和十一年的测量。
body 意为“身体”，我记得的是前面那一具，1972 年被画下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
body 为抽象总称，祖母说身体是唯一会因为被好好休息而变好的东西。

1978 年祖母说，身体是唯一会因为被好好休息而变好的东西。（body）

The body, meaning the frame and not the person, was sixty kilos and was carried by whoever came last.
Every body in that class had the same chart.
The body at the front, meaning the one the surgeon stood at and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured properly.
My father said body was the whole of the person, meaning the self and not the frame.
